title.zh: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web
title.en: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web

current_state.zh: The Wikimedia Foundation urged courts in major AI copyright cases to protect LLM training on copyrighted works while preventing chatbots from regurgitating that material, warning that an overly broad ruling could threaten the open web.
current_state.en: The Wikimedia Foundation urged courts in major AI copyright cases to protect LLM training on copyrighted works while preventing chatbots from regurgitating that material, warning that an overly broad ruling could threaten the open web.
